Subject: Urgent: Project Submission and Performance Discussion

Hi [Employee Name],

I am writing to address the missed deadline for the recent project submission. This is not the first time this has happened, and it is becoming a concerning pattern.

Meeting deadlines is a fundamental expectation of your role, and consistent failure to do so impacts the entire team. We need to schedule a meeting as soon as possible to discuss this issue seriously. It is critical that we address these performance gaps immediately to determine if you can meet the basic requirements of your position moving forward.

Please let me know your availability for a meeting today or tomorrow.

Regards,

[Your Name]
